verdict.rationale: Smithery's build docs cover publishing an MCP server you have already built and deployed (URL method, a public HTTPS URL, or an MCPB bundle for stdio), and Uplink exposes an MCP server already running on a machine. Nothing in the pack shows generating an MCP server from an OpenAPI definition or wrapping custom code so that the developer avoids writing MCP protocol plumbing. The OAuth and credential handling in the docs is consumer-side connection management, not server authoring, so it does not count toward this story.
